Re-entry (buy) only on all four conditions: rates ≤4.8–5.0% and USD stable, clean Oct 21 print with reaffirmed guide, legal path resolved, and price in the $185–205 evidence zone.

**Bottom line**: A well-governed, high-cash, low-growth company whose AI re-rating thesis was disproven in the last reported quarter, now caught between an open legal tail and the two macro channels (10Y, USD) that most hurt its equity. The asymmetry is to the downside; the multiple still assumes re-acceleration that the data refute. Sell/invalidate rather than defend — and treat the three missing analyst inputs (Value, Growth, Geo-Legal) as a precondition for ever re-rating this to an initiate.
